Description: John Hobbes enters the Attic, reflecting alone and hearing distant thunder. He recalls his past actions, showing confusion and guilt about what happened before.
Location: Attic（Attic）
Key Information:
  - After entering the Attic, John Hobbes pauses for a moment and says that he 'messed up'.
  - He recalls details of a certain case, mentioning that he investigated relatives, even though that information was not important to the case itself.
  - A window is opened; the view and atmosphere in the Attic feel quiet.
  - A rumbling sound of distant thunder can be heard.
  - John Hobbes feels his memory is blurry and cannot remember certain things he has done—especially whether he ever pulled the trigger.
  - John Hobbes prays to God for forgiveness, revealing inner struggle and repentance.
Characters:
  [John Hobbes（John Hobbes）] Person No. 1, a visitor.
    · Talks to himself after entering the Attic, expressing regret about what he has done.
    · Cannot remember certain actions, especially whether he pulled the trigger.
    · Prays for God’s forgiveness while consumed by guilt.
